import torch


def compute(z, theta_1_1, theta_1_2, theta_2_1, theta_2_2, s, use_behaviour, v_pi_0, v_pi_1):
    z0 = z[:, 0]
    z1 = z[:, 1]
    rz0 = z0 / s
    rz1 = z1 / s

    t110 = theta_1_1[:, 0]
    t111 = theta_1_1[:, 1]
    t120 = theta_1_2[:, 0]
    t121 = theta_1_2[:, 1]
    t210 = theta_2_1[:, 0]
    t211 = theta_2_1[:, 1]
    t220 = theta_2_2[:, 0]
    t221 = theta_2_2[:, 1]

    d10 = -((rz0 - t110) ** 2 + (rz1 - t111) ** 2)
    d11 = -((rz0 - t120) ** 2 + (rz1 - t121) ** 2)
    first = d10 <= d11

    ta0 = torch.where(first, t110, t120)
    ta1 = torch.where(first, t111, t121)
    loss1 = torch.where(first, d10, d11)

    dz0 = rz0 - ta0
    dz1 = rz1 - ta1
    rho = ta0 * dz0 + ta1 * dz1
    R0 = rho
    R1 = dz0 + rho * ta0
    R2 = dz1 + rho * ta1

    vp0 = use_behaviour * torch.where(first, v_pi_0[:, 0], v_pi_1[:, 0])
    vp1 = use_behaviour * torch.where(first, v_pi_0[:, 1], v_pi_1[:, 1])

    nv = torch.sqrt(vp0 ** 2 + vp1 ** 2)
    pos = nv > 0
    nz = torch.where(pos, nv, torch.ones_like(nv))
    h = torch.where(pos, torch.sinh(nv) / nz, torch.ones_like(nv))
    m0 = torch.cosh(nv)
    m1 = h * vp0
    m2 = h * vp1

    den1 = 1 - (m1 * ta0 + m2 * ta1)

    u1a = m1 * t210 + m2 * t211
    q1 = u1a / (1 + m0)
    X10 = u1a
    X11 = t210 + q1 * m1
    X12 = t211 + q1 * m2
    sX1 = -m0 * X10 + m1 * X11 + m2 * X12
    W10 = X10 + (sX1 / den1) * m0
    W11 = X11 + (sX1 / den1) * (m1 + ta0)
    W12 = X12 + (sX1 / den1) * (m2 + ta1)

    u2a = m1 * t220 + m2 * t221
    q2 = u2a / (1 + m0)
    X20 = u2a
    X21 = t220 + q2 * m1
    X22 = t221 + q2 * m2
    sX2 = -m0 * X20 + m1 * X21 + m2 * X22
    W20 = X20 + (sX2 / den1) * m0
    W21 = X21 + (sX2 / den1) * (m1 + ta0)
    W22 = X22 + (sX2 / den1) * (m2 + ta1)

    d20 = (R0 - W10) ** 2 - (R1 - W11) ** 2 - (R2 - W12) ** 2
    d21 = (R0 - W20) ** 2 - (R1 - W21) ** 2 - (R2 - W22) ** 2
    loss2 = torch.where(d20 <= d21, d20, d21)

    return loss1 + loss2
